taxonomy_notes.client_type: USACE HNC is the contracting agency (federal_dod). DHA/KACC is the using agency (also federal_dod). Both are DoD.
taxonomy_notes.program_type: KACC is a military ambulatory care center. healthcare_va_medical is technically VA-specific per vocab; the correct type for a DoD/Army ambulatory care center is healthcare_ambulatory or healthcare_military_medical. See vocab gap in retro.
taxonomy_notes.program_subtype: healthcare_ambulatory used as closest match. Facility is a military medical treatment facility (MTF) — Kimbrough Ambulatory Care Center.
taxonomy_notes.delivery_method: SOW and BOD both confirm design-build. BOD cover states 'Design-Build'.
taxonomy_notes.contract_vehicle: Task order under a multi-project base IDIQ (W912DY-22-C-00__). The SOW title 'FY22 Eastern Region Miscellaneous Projects' indicates a multi-project MACC/IDIQ vehicle. federal_task_order + federal_matoc flagged; may be federal_macc.
taxonomy_notes.project_status: BOD dated October 2023; final design submitted. Assumed complete given Final BOD and no indication of ongoing work. Status flagged as uncertain — no completion certificate or as-built drawings available.
taxonomy_notes.award_type: Award basis not stated in available documents. Design-build procurement basis not specified as QBS or best-value in SOW.
taxonomy_notes.bfa_role: BFA holds the prime design-build contract (BOD states 'BFA Project #22-060A' and BOD is for design-build delivery).

drawings.notes: No drawing set provided in source documents. BOD references design-build delivery and indicates drawings would be produced as part of the design submittal package, but no drawing PDFs are present in the intake folder.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: healthcare_ambulatory (program_subtype) with a note about healthcare_military_medical
